title: Nourishing Crispy Slovakian Chorizo Skillet
description: A savory and satisfying Slovakian dish featuring crispy chorizo, this skillet is perfect for a crowd and can be made in a traditional ttukbaegi earthenware pot, it is also flexitarian friendly
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large ttukbaegi earthenware pot or skillet over medium high heat
Add the sliced chorizo and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes
Remove the chorizo from the pot and set aside
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes
Add the chopped potato, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 5 minutes
Add the crispy chorizo back to the pot and stir to combine
Reduce heat to medium low and cook for an additional 10 minutes, stirring occasionally
